title: Why Are American Health Care Costs So High?
summary: John Green explains why the US spends far more on health care than other countries, going through insurers, drug companies, hospitals and lawyers. He argues the causes are complicated rather than a simple blame game.
why: Pointed to as a quick, readable summary of the data behind US healthcare costs.

quote.text: This video (which has been making its rounds) explains many of the contributing factors to the cost of healthcare.
